question: By how much did accident-year 2022 reported loss (paid plus case) develop between the 31 December 2022 and 31 December 2025 valuations?
final_text:
Accident-year 2022 reported loss (indemnity paid net of recoveries, plus case reserves, excluding ALAE and IBNR) developed by about £2.19m between the two valuations.

I counted only claims with an accident date in 2022 and a report date on or before the valuation date. I included only indemnity transactions dated on or before that valuation date.

| Valuation date | AY2022 reported loss |
|---|---|
| 31 Dec 2022 | £12,882,431.30 |
| 31 Dec 2025 | £15,074,982.14 |
| Development | £2,192,550.84 |

ANSWER: 2192550.84

input.query: select v.d, sum(t.amount) from (select date '2022-12-31' d union all select date '2025-12-31') v join claim c on c.accident_date between date '2022-01-01' and date '2022-12-31' join claim_txn t on t.claim_id=c.claim_id and t.txn_date<=v.d and t.cost_type='INDEMNITY' and c.report_date<=v.d group by v.d
